name: 龍祈澔
objective:
本課程重點將讓學生認識投影與布幕的相互關係，從不同的光源與反射體的應用創造出視訊投影的藝術作品。利用介紹案例的方式，讓學生認識不同形式的投影藝術，其中包含 2D 牆面投影藝術、3D 建築投影藝術、球型投影、浮空投影等。
This course aims at providing students the knowledge of projector and screen. Case studies allow students to understand varying types of projection art, including 2D projection on wall, 3D projection on building, spherical projection and holographic projection.

延伸教學與資源: ● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources) 採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如 OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）● 深入探討 AI 的原理與應用（Explore the principles and applications of AI in depth）
